title: Order early. Pick up early. Custom eggless cakes for Riverstone and Box Hill.
summary:
Riverstone opens at 6am on weekdays. That's not early. That's on time — for the parent picking up a birthday cake before the school run in Vineyard, or the Box Hill order collected on the way to work.

48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes — no shortcuts, no pre-made stock in the case. Six sizes, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Mango, and every cake is 100% eggless. Not some cakes. Every one.

Free parking at the shopping centre. WhatsApp your order: +61 425 697 725.
